White Outside Corner Ledger

Home Brick White White Outside Corner Ledger
The outside corner ledger is engineered to fasten onto the shiplap of the 90° outside corner panel. The sloped design of the straight ledger makes it difficult to miter perfectly, making this inside corner ledger an ideal solution if you intend to transition your ledger through a 90° outside corner.
